wallGirtSelectionResult.reason: This workbook is the MAIN project frame/BOM calculator, not 'Калькулятор ограждайки v1.5.xlsx'. It has no wind-pressure-driven auto-selection, no aerodynamic coefficient, no k(ze) table — none of the inputs src/calc/wallGirt/windLoad.ts implements appear anywhere in this sheet. Instead it computes wall material as a flat, enclosure-conditional quantity formula (profile family ПП/ПС at various sizes) plus a single 'Кронштейны' (brackets) row with linear-meter and mass formulas summing zone perimeters. No single 'selected profile + шаг ригелей + число рядов' output exists in the form our wallGirt.ts model produces.
